name: Statistics
description: Summary statistics and percentiles for lists of numbers.

operations.name: stats.summary
operations.description: Computes count, sum, mean, min, and max over a list of numbers.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Array of numbers; entries that are not numbers are skipped

operations.howto: Keep the entries with list.append (items become objects like {id, value}) and bind "values" from that state array with a pluck transform, e.g. transforms [{"type": "pluck", "parameters": {"field": "value"}}]. To refresh the stats when an entry is added, put a second click binding for this operation on the same button; bindings on one event run in order. Route each output you need to a state key. An empty list returns zeros instead of an error.

operations.name: stats.percentile
operations.description: Computes the p-th percentile of a list of numbers with linear interpolation.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Array of numbers; entries that are not numbers are skipped

operations.howto: Bind values like stats.summary (a pluck transform projects a field across an array of objects). Bind p as a constant with a typed numeric value, for example value 95 for the 95th percentile; p 50 is the median. Route the value output to a state key. An empty list is an error, and p outside 0 to 100 is an error.
